content: PostgreSQL 17 CREATE TABLE / ddl-generated-columns docs list no restriction on FKs involving STORED generated columns; empirically on PG 16.2 an FK ON a generated column (NO ACTION) and an FK REFERENCING a generated column covered by a UNIQUE constraint both create and enforce correctly, including DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED. Restrictions the docs do state: no column default, no identity, not in a partition key, no reference to another generated column, immutable functions only.
